We have applied template 167677, which seems to be a deprotection of an amide? The result gave three possible precursors (SMILES). They look like:

1. C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)OC(=O)NC(=O)CCl)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO
2. C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](OC(=O)NC(=O)CCl)[C@H]1C)CO
3. C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)COC(=O)NC(=O)CCl

We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999.

We need to find precursors for each of these. Likely the target is a natural product with a lactone? The template seems to break an ether to give a hydroxyl? Actually the template is [C:2]-[OH]>>Cl-C-C(=O)-N-C(=O)-[O]-[C:2] (i.e., converting an alcohol to a protected amide? Not sure.)

But we have three possible precursors. We need to choose a plausible route.

We need to check if these precursors are commercially available. Use is_buyable.

Let's check each precursor.
